comingLast.roast: tied for last with Matthews - one of them buys, both of them stay
tied for last with Grant - one of them buys, both of them stay
a 1-point cushion over Grant - thin ice, heavy walker
with 4 to play and 3 in hand, boring golf is beautiful golf
above Grant by 4 - close enough to hear the engraver
7 clear with 2 left - the survival pars start now
hovering 8 above the double blue - altitude: uncomfortable
one quiet stretch from joining Grant in the conversation nobody wants
10 above the cellar door with 1 to play - just keep scoring
